title: Wet 솔로 #033 · glamour hourglass · 샴페인 코발트 · 손 허리 · 겨울 눈 광장 · 구풍
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, early 20s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, top bun honey blonde hair, soaking wet, slicked and clinging in wet strands — full body champagne-drenched glistening cobalt fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid wet-look body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a continuous glossy wet-look coating over her entire body, thick sheets and streams of liquid running down every curve in glistening rivulets, countless beads and droplets clinging to the surface and dripping from her chin, fingertips, hips and knees, razor-sharp bright specular highlights along every curve, nothing lying flat. Dense wet surface — BLAZING cobalt-blue pigment across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, drenched in fizzing champagne, VIVID golden champagne spraying in a fizzing arc over her and streaming down her body in sparkling rivulets, tiny bubbles and foam bursting on the surface and droplets sparkling in the air, mirror-wet glossy, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same glistening wet cobalt, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.

Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, water droplets beading across her skin and a wet glistening sheen and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip.

Background: a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
